BIOLOGY — TERMLY EXAM #3
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: BIOLOGY
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Response and Coordination 3.2 Support and Movement Page 12 of 38 1 STRAND 1.0: C? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Response and Coordination 3.2 Support and Movement Page 12 of 38 1 STRAND 1.0: C.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Response and Coordination 3.2 Support and Movement Page 12 of 38 1 STRAND 1.0: C.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Response and Coordination 3.2 Support and Movement Page 12 of 38 1 STRAND 1.0: C.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Response and Coordination 3.2 Support and Movement Page 12 of 38 1 STRAND 1.0: C.

2. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   B. Removing all vegetation
   C. Burning crop residue every week
   D. Overgrazing continuously

3. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only carbon dioxide
   B. Glucose and oxygen
   C. Nitrogen gas only
   D. Only water vapour

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Support and Movement 3.0 Anatomy and Physiology of Animals 3.1 Response and Coor? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Support and Movement 3.0 Anatomy and Physiology of Animals 3.1 Response and Coor.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Support and Movement 3.0 Anatomy and Physiology of Animals 3.1 Response and Coor.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Support and Movement 3.0 Anatomy and Physiology of Animals 3.1 Response and Coor.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Support and Movement 3.0 Anatomy and Physiology of Animals 3.1 Response and Coor.

5. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. A chemical reaction forming ash
   B. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   C. Heating until a solid melts
   D. Movement of water only across a membrane

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Response and Coordination 2.2 Support and Movement 3.0 Anatomy and Physiology of? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Response and Coordination 2.2 Support and Movement 3.0 Anatomy and Physiology of.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Response and Coordination 2.2 Support and Movement 3.0 Anatomy and Physiology of.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Response and Coordination 2.2 Support and Movement 3.0 Anatomy and Physiology of.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Response and Coordination 2.2 Support and Movement 3.0 Anatomy and Physiology of.

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Genetics? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Genetics.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Genetics.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Genetics.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Genetics.

8. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 37 °C
   B. 100 °C
   C. 50 °C
   D. 0 °C

9. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. pascal (Pa)
   B. watt (W)
   C. newton (N)
   D. joule (J)

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Response and Coordination in Plants? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Response and Coordination in Plants.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Response and Coordination in Plants.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Response and Coordination in Plants.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Response and Coordination in Plants.

11. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Paper burning to ash
   B. Iron rusting
   C. Ice melting to water
   D. Milk souring

12. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   B. Any white crystal used in cooking
   C. Any substance that conducts electricity
   D. A mixture of two liquids

13. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   B. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   C. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   D. A compound can be separated by filtering only

14. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Support in Plants? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Support in Plants.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Support in Plants.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Support in Plants.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Support in Plants.

15. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Response and Coordination in Animals? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Response and Coordination in Animals.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Response and Coordination in Animals.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Response and Coordination in Animals.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Response and Coordination in Animals.

16. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Primary consumers only
   B. Tertiary consumers
   C. Decomposers only
   D. Producers

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Response and Coordination in Animals and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Support and Movement Page 12 of 38 1 STRAND 1.0: CELL BIOLOGY AND BIODIVERSITY S and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Support and Movement in Animals and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Genetics and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Evolution and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Response and Coordination 2.2 Support and Movement 3.0 Anatomy and Physiology of and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
